description: Synthetic expected outcomes for typed relationships between distinct document versions. Identifiers are illustrative; factual summaries are limited to the cited public filings.

relationships.scope: 2012 financial statements in Amendment No. 1, as identified by the 8-K; the 8-K reports the Audit Committee conclusion and planned Amendment No. 2, it is not itself the correcting annual filing
restated 2012 financial statements and related disclosures, limited to revisions identified in Amendment No. 2
additional spreadsheet computational errors and resulting 2012 financial statement corrections compared with Amendment No. 1; preserve periods and data expressly unchanged

assertions: All filings remain distinct document identities.
A later amended filing does not erase the original or the intervening non-reliance declaration.
Non-reliance is not treated as proof that every later reported value is independently true.
The exact affected statements/notes must be extracted from the filings before scope is accepted.
The 8-K is a current report communicating the Audit Committee conclusion; it is not Amendment No. 2 itself.
Amendment No. 2 identifies both the original 10-K and Amendment No. 1; represent its relationships as separate directed assertions with separately bounded scopes.
Some interim 2011 information is expressly unchanged from Amendment No. 1; do not mark every historical figure as corrected.

relationships.scope: amended/restated financial statements and notes; revisions to Item 2 (MD&A) and Item 4 (Controls and Procedures), as expressly stated in the Explanatory Note
relationships.unaffected_scope: other information in the original Report expressly stated as not amended by this Amendment; this is not a finding that such information is correct or independently verified

assertions: The amended filing and original filing remain distinct documents.
Do not mark the entire original filing as replaced when the amendment identifies limited sections.
Preserve the filing's own limitation that other information is not amended and that the amendment speaks as of the original filing except as stated.
The exact section-level scope must be checked against the filing before implementation acceptance.
The filing states that no other information in the Report is amended; preserve this as a declared unaffected scope, not as positive corroboration.
The amendment speaks as of the original Report filing date except for the certifications; do not conflate that asserted temporal effect with publication, detection, retrieval, or SINAYXA record time.
Preserve both directed edges.
Do not infer that C corrects all of A unless C explicitly declares that relationship.
Do not attribute the correction to the issuer without evidence.
Review status is independent of attribution.
Do not silently choose one interpretation.
Contrary evidence and review rationale remain available.
The asserted effective date does not move recorded_at backwards.
The earlier historical view cannot include a relationship recorded later.

cases.mutation: CORRECTS A->B and CORRECTS B->A for same scope
third-party report attribution silently changed to ISSUER_STATEMENT
affected_scope omitted or silently expanded from partial section to whole document
relationship recorded after knowledge_cutoff appears in earlier as-of query
relationship supersedes itself or points to a later recorded assertion
chronology or textual similarity alone creates a relationship
provenance edge or same-source supersedes pointer is reused as a document correction relation
